name: Lolotte
message: 「Shall we all go somewhere together after this!?」

name: Misa
message: 「You always perk right up the second school's out.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Well, Treasurer-san went to a cake shop, and Senpai-san went to a traditional sweets shop. That's just not fair!」

name: Synn
message: 「It was for club activities, so it couldn't be helped.」

name: Misa
message: 「Even though you're always making detours to snack.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Then, Milady, shall I come to pick you up later?」

name: Synn
message: 「Lately, there's this girl I keep seeing around.」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't tell me she's stalking you, Sakura-kun!」

name: Misa
message: 「The one who's going to crush you is none other than me, Sakura-kun!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You've got it all wrong, Vice President-san. Surely, that girl has her eye on President-san.」

name: Misa
message: 「W-What a wonderful situation! S-So those kinds of shojo-manga moments actually happen in real life... Ba-dump.\s04」

name: Lolotte
message: 「A girl with a crush on President-san. Now I'm curious.」

name: Synn
message: 「Like I said, it's not like that's decided--」

name: Misa
message: 「She probably thinks she's hidden, but she's in plain sight. Quite a cute girl, isn't she... And yet, to think she's after Sakura-kun...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「...I'm terribly sorry, you two. Would you mind if we called off stopping by anywhere today?」

name: Misa
message: 「I don't particularly mind, though... Right, Sakura-kun?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Thank you very much. Now then, Jiiya... let's go home.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Please start the car right away. I beg of you.」
The unfamiliar girl reaches a hand out toward the car.
Yet, there was no way she could reach. Dropping her shoulders, she turned her back on the car.
At the sight of her looking so tragic, we couldn't even call out to her, able only to watch her go.

name: Synn
message: 「Don't go saying she actually had her eye on Lolotte instead of me, okay?」

name: Misa
message: 「Quit joking around. Did you notice anything?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. She didn't use an honorific with her name.」
What on earth could have happened between that girl and Lolotte?
